title: Release Notes Transparency Requests (Customer Log)
content:
Spreadsheet: customer requests for model/version change transparency

Legend
- Urgency: P0 (blocking renewal/security), P1 (blocking rollout/POC), P2 (important but workaround exists), P3 (nice-to-have)
- Preferred formats: Console tab, Email digest, RSS/Atom feed, JSON feed, API field/header (model_version + changelog_url), Webhook (out of scope v1)
- Status: logged | validating | planned | beta_candidate | in_beta | GA_ready | deferred

Columns
Account | Segment | Deployment | Data sensitivity | Primary request | Preferred formats | Required details | SLA/retention expectations | Urgency | Requested on | Source | CSM/Owner | Status | Notes / next step

Rows
StackForge | Mid-market devtools | Hosted + Dedicated (eval) | Medium | Consistent customer-visible release notes per model version; avoid “silent changes” during A/B | Console tab; RSS/Atom; API field/header | model_id + version_id; effective date/time; compatibility notes (tool calling/ctx window); deprecation timelines; rollback guidance | Wants immutable history; 12 mo retention | P1 | 2026-02-05 | Fireflies ff_2026-02-05_stackforge_technical_deep_dive | Owen Phillips | beta_candidate | Asked for RSS specifically for internal platform team; follow up after console beta flag plan.
FinchBank | Enterprise fintech | Private (VPC) + Dedicated | High (regulated) | Auditable model change-management artifacts for procurement and change-control | Console export (CSV/PDF); JSON feed; API field/header | who approved; published timestamp; signed/tamper-evident history; deprecation & replacement model; security/policy notes (customer-safe) | Retention >= 7 years preferred; immutable/tamper-evident; RBAC for who can publish | P0 | 2026-01-29 | Jira SUP-18421 + Fireflies ff_2026-02-11_finchbank_security_review | Dev Patel | planned | Security questionnaire expects “immutable change log” language; align with audit events + publish history.
HelioHealth | Enterprise health tech | Dedicated (POC) | High (HIPAA adjacent) | Release notes required for any model version change before enabling in production | Email digest; Console tab | effective date/time; “impact summary” plain language; any known issues; compatibility (ctx window, embeddings dims) | Needs 24–72h advance notice for planned changes; 24 mo retention | P1 | 2026-02-14 | Fireflies ff_2026-02-14_heliohealth_poc_scoping | Owen Phillips | validating | They care more about “notice” than feed format; may accept weekly digest + console link.
Northpeak Research | AI startup | Hosted | Low/Medium | Machine-readable changelog feed + surfaced resolved model version (pinning transparency) | JSON feed; RSS/Atom; API field/header | version_id; changelog_url; perf notes (latency/cost) acceptable; eval links ok | No formal retention ask; wants fast updates | P2 | 2026-02-22 | Fireflies ff_2026-02-22_northpeak_demo | Dev Patel | planned | Strong PLG signal; likely to publicize if we ship an RSS/JSON feed.
BrightScribe | Mid-market SaaS | Hosted | Medium | “What changed” when outputs shift; needs rollback path documentation | Console tab; Email digest | known issues; behavior changes (high-level); rollback instructions; pinned version behavior | Wants 6 mo history minimum | P2 | 2026-02-07 | Support conversation (no ticket) | Owen Phillips | logged | Recommend console changelog + link from error analysis workflows.
GigaTel SupportOps | Enterprise telecom | Dedicated | High | Formal deprecation schedule and replacement model mapping | Console export (CSV); Email digest | sunset_date; replacement_model; compatibility delta; migration checklist | 12–24 mo notice for major sunsets | P1 | 2026-02-12 | CSM notes | Dev Patel | validating | Flag for deprecation fields completeness; tie to policy doc once ready.
LumenPay | Enterprise payments | Private (on-prem) | High | Offline-accessible release notes for audits (air-gapped constraints) | Export (PDF); periodic bundle via support portal | full release note text; hashes/signatures; publication history | 7 yr retention; immutable | P0 | 2026-02-16 | Security review follow-up (email) | Dev Patel | planned | Needs packaging story for Private/on-prem docs sync; may require quarterly “changelog pack”.
Arcadia LegalTech | Mid-market | Hosted | Medium | Wants to subscribe to updates per-model (not global feed) | RSS/Atom per model; Console filters | per-model feed; effective date; compatibility notes | none stated | P3 | 2026-02-03 | Sales notes | Owen Phillips | deferred | Per-model RSS is planned in docs IA but might not be MVP; track as enhancement.
OpenHarbor Analytics | Startup | Hosted | Low | Wants API to query changelog entries by version_id for automation | API endpoint; JSON feed | pagination/filter by model_id/version_id; stable IDs; ETag caching | none stated | P2 | 2026-02-08 | Slack connect w/ eng contact | Dev Patel | planned | Align to endpoint semantics + caching; also asked for “since=timestamp”.
Greenline Insurance | Enterprise insurance | Dedicated | High | Needs evidence of review/approval before publication (internal policy) | Console; Export (CSV/PDF) | approver role; review timestamps; “published vs draft” clarity | 3 yr retention minimum | P1 | 2026-02-10 | Support escalation | Owen Phillips | validating | Similar to FinchBank but less strict on 7 yr retention.
QuantaERP | Mid-market | Hosted | Medium | Wants “breaking change” taxonomy and clear compatibility section | Console; Email digest | change type (perf/bugfix/compat/deprecation); compatibility matrix | none stated | P2 | 2026-02-04 | Customer success check-in | Dev Patel | planned | Route to PM taxonomy work; provide sample template once style guide lands.
NovaBio Informatics | Enterprise biotech | Private (VPC) | High | Wants changelog tied to rollouts (“what changed when we moved traffic”) | Console rollout history integration | link rollout event -> changelog entry at time; version pin evidence | 24 mo history | P1 | 2026-02-20 | Fireflies ff_2026-02-20_enterprise_change_management_checkin | Owen Phillips | planned | Explicit ask after confusing rollout; prioritize rollout cross-linking.
KiteWorks Automation | Startup | Hosted | Low | Wants “diff” style info for metadata changes (context window, tool calling support) | JSON feed; Console | metadata fields changed; before/after; effective date | none | P3 | 2026-02-06 | Product feedback form | Dev Patel | deferred | v1 likely provides summary + links; true diffs may be too internal/noisy.
Asteria Education | Mid-market | Hosted | Medium | Wants advance notice of deprecations and “last supported date” | Email digest; Console | deprecation timeline; replacement model; migration tips | 90 days notice desired | P2 | 2026-02-09 | Support call | Owen Phillips | logged | Provide interim manual comms until generator is live.
SummitSec | Enterprise security vendor | Dedicated | High | Needs public statement that changelog is tamper-evident and retained | Docs statement; Console link | retention policy; immutability mechanism description (customer-safe); audit export availability | 5–7 yr retention | P0 | 2026-02-18 | Procurement/security questionnaire | Dev Patel | planned | Coordinate with Security & Compliance on standard language.

Hot tickets / explicit complaints (behavior changed without notice)
- SUP-18455: “Pinned version appears unchanged but output differs” -> root cause suspected missing/incorrect metadata + generator gap. Urgency P0 for that account; resolution depends on schema correctness + changelog publish discipline.
- SUP-18502: “Changelog entry wording confusing” -> customer wants correction mechanism preserving history (audit-friendly). Reinforces need for supersede/rollback flow.
- SUP-18473: “RSS/API feed of model updates” -> supports docs work on RSS/Atom + JSON feed.

Quick roll-up (counts as of 2026-02-23)
- Total logged accounts: 15
- Urgency: P0=4, P1=6, P2=4, P3=1
- Format demand (multiple per account): Console=11, Email digest=6, RSS/Atom=6, JSON feed=6, API field/header=7, Export PDF/CSV=5, Webhook=1 (out of scope v1)
- Most requested required details: effective timestamp, compatibility notes, deprecation timelines, “resolved model_version” exposure, and audit/approval history (enterprise)

Notes to self (CS)
- Several enterprise requests are really “change-management evidence” more than “release notes content.” We should treat exportability + immutability language as first-class.
- Beta program candidate list (initial): FinchBank (security heavy), StackForge (format heavy), NovaBio (rollout linkage), HelioHealth (notice + regulated). Need PM sign-off on beta access + expectations.
